scope: Current discovery-1 bar-detector baseline; no changes to live detection or plans
selection: Every event in the frozen 322-event discovery-audit ledger, without sampling, return ranking or outcome exclusions
label: Unchanged legacy next-minute open to 30-minute close less 0.5 percentage points; missing labels retained. Not a triple-barrier or executable quote result.
availability: Historical final bars under explicit zero-latency-at-minute-end scenario. No historical receipt times or revisions available. Features must ignore incomplete bars and future receipts when supplied.

hypotheses.rule: Keep signals at least 30 minutes after open and strictly before 30 minutes prior to close
hypotheses.rationale: User-requested separation of first and last 30 minutes; no threshold search

hypotheses.rule: Keep three-completed-minute price rise of at least one pre-window ATR
hypotheses.rationale: One volatility unit is a fixed diagnostic scale, not a fitted profitable cutoff. ATR is the simple mean of 14 true ranges ending before the three-minute expansion, with an additional prior close.

missing_features: UNKNOWN, never treated as zero or a negative signal. Compare selected rows with the baseline on the same feature-observable population; also publish full baseline and all excluded/missing cases.
comparison: One feature at a time; no combined filter or optimizer. Frozen signal ledger means this is a post-detection ablation, not re-running cooldown or shortlist after rejection.

statistics.family_adjustment: Bonferroni percentile interval: 1 - 0.05/2 per comparison, same resampled sessions for subset and comparator
statistics.p_value_reason: No confirmatory inference from exposed selected symbols, small session count and outcome-dependent missingness

calendar_request.reason: Exchange-local session boundaries including early closes; metadata only

stop_rule: Publish every diagnostic and missing result; do not retune thresholds on these data. Advance any hypothesis only after source-qualified independent evaluation. No profitability or accuracy claim.
